historical_record.description: The two older Telephone Company buildings on the 19th Avenue frontage were built to house telephone operators.

The property held a Pacific Telephone and Telegraph Company communications equipment building and two older Telephone Company buildings fronting on 19th Avenue, with a parking lot. The City Planning Commission approved, with conditions, a westward expansion of the Pacific Telephone and Telegraph Company communications equipment building toward 20th Avenue, with the two older buildings on 19th Avenue to be demolished for parking.
